title: Giant World Map
html:
Not to be confused with World or Known World.

This map is much like the map World. Except this is bigger.

A giant map of the World. The map’s terrain is comprised of an even amount of flat, hilly and mountainous terrain that is quite evenly spread through the map. However, Asia tends to be more mountainous, Africa tends to be more hilly and South America tends to be more flat.

However, it should be noted that most of the map of water and with the Panama and Suez canals being a thing, this results in this being one of the best maps for trade ships and warships.

Nations

The map features 107 named nations, including Türkiye, Germany, France, Spain, Italy and United Kingdom.

Map data

  • Categories: World
  • Nations: 107
  • Public rotation frequency: 10

Technical

The size of the map is 4110 x 1948.[1]
